simple.meaning: חָפָה (châphâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to cover ; by implication, to veil , to encase , protect.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 12 times in 2 Samuel, 2 Chronicles, Esther, Psalms, Jeremiah, beginning at 2 Samuel 15:30. The surrounding contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָפָה (H2645) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: חָפָה (châphâh) / H2645 is traced through 2 Samuel 15:30, 2 Chronicles 3:5, 2 Chronicles 3:7, 2 Chronicles 3:8 with source-language evidence and verse context.

structuredEvidence.definition: to cover ; by implication, to veil , to encase , protect

firstOccurrence.englishText: David went up by the ascent of the Mount of Olives, and wept as he went up; and he had his head covered, and went barefoot. All the people who were with him each covered his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

definitions.short: to cover ; by implication, to veil , to encase , protect
definitions.full: H2645. chaphah [ חָפָה ] verb cover (Late Hebrew id. , especially Pi`el; Aramaic חֲפָא , (especially Pa`el); Arabic be hidden , hide ) — Qal Perfect חָפוּ 2Sam 15:30 3 t.; Participle חָפוּי 15:30 ; construct חֲפוּי Est 6:12 ; — cover the head ( ראֹשׁ ), in token of grief 2Sam 15:30 ; Jer 14:3-4 , participle agrees with ׳ר 2Sam 15:30 ; ראֹשׁ חֲפוּי || (אָבֵלׅ Est 6:12 ; in token of sentence of death 7:8 . Niph`al Participle feminine נֶחְמָּה Psa 68:13 ( נ יונה ׳כנפי ), with בְּ of material. Pi`el Perfect (late) חִמָּה 2Che Psa 3:8 ; Psalm 3:9; Imperfect וַיְחַף 2Chr 3:7 ; suffix וַיְחַמֵּהוּ 3:5 , 8 ; overlay followed by 2 accusative (one of material) 3:5 (twice in verse); 3:7-8 , 9 .
